codeceptManifest.scope: Frozen provenance mapping for the retired test/end-to-end/mvFeatures source; the 57 historical capability baseline is an aggregate across the former legacy inventory, not a Codecept-only executable count

capabilities.name: Core document loading and media types
capabilities.covered: Both historical standalone Codecept PDF-loading journeys are retired: Playwright smoke proves local fixture loading, rendered page readiness, canvas dimensions and navigation. Functional tests exceed them with image loading, PDF replacement/rendered page identity, unsupported-media diagnostics, and separate failed-PDF and failed-image rendered-state contracts
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap. The standalone Functional suite does not require AAT, DM Store or other shared service state; audio/video playback is tracked under Multimedia playback

capabilities.name: AAT document prerequisites
capabilities.execution: The three external CCD browser contracts are ticketed with EXUI-5123 and excluded from standard standalone selection
capabilities.covered: Three Playwright browser contracts preserve the historical PDF, image and Word CCD upload journeys. The standalone Media Viewer Functional suite deliberately uses deterministic document and service responses instead of shared DM Store state
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap. EXUI-5123 is an external CCD browser defect: the three tagged Playwright contracts remain discoverable through the opt-in external-service diagnostic command until the mandatory Document field binds successful uploads

capabilities.name: CCD case creation prerequisite
capabilities.execution: The external CCD browser hand-off contract is ticketed with EXUI-5122 and excluded from standard standalone selection
capabilities.covered: A Playwright browser contract preserves the historical authenticated CCD case-details hand-off. Media Viewer Functional tests do not require CCD setup or credentials
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap. EXUI-5122 is an external CCD browser defect: the tagged Playwright contract remains discoverable through the opt-in external-service diagnostic command until an authenticated caseworker can open the case-details route

capabilities.name: Office document conversion
capabilities.covered: Nine Functional contracts submit Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text and RTF conversion requests, prove returned-PDF rendering, and cover HTTP 400/500 failure propagation, timeout handling and malformed-PDF handling through deterministic Document Assembly responses
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap identified in this standalone slice

capabilities.name: Page navigation
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers next/previous, page input, rendered page identity, viewport state and document boundaries
capabilities.gap: Bundle and nested-document destination coverage is provided by Index and outline; no remaining legacy migration gap.

capabilities.name: Zoom
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers PDF/image round-trip and minimum/maximum scale boundaries
capabilities.gap: No remaining high-value gap identified in this standalone slice

capabilities.name: Rotation
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers PDF orientation and image transform round-trips using intrinsic rendered state, reset after PDF document replacement, default-state reset after reload for both media types, and restoration of server-supplied PDF orientation metadata through a deterministic metadata response
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap. The standalone demo exposes no Save rotation control, so persistence writes are not a Viewer UI contract

capabilities.name: Search
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers positive search, next/previous, no results, close/reset, recovery, Enter navigation and rendered highlight-all, exact-case and whole-word option contracts
capabilities.gap: No remaining high-value gap identified in this standalone slice

capabilities.name: Comments panel
capabilities.covered: All historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright covers direct-toolbar panel lifecycle; create, update, removal and cancel semantics; immediate and rehydrated rendered state; stale-highlight reset, no-result and multi-result search; cross-page search navigation; rendered summary/page-link navigation; document-isolated persistence; and selected-text/two-comment summary coverage supplied by PDF annotations
capabilities.gap: No remaining high-value gap identified in this standalone slice

capabilities.name: PDF annotations and comments
capabilities.covered: All seven historical Codecept UI scenarios are retired. Playwright covers real PDF text selection, distinct draw-box geometry through reload, request and rendered geometry, comment persistence through rotation and rehydration, two-comment collation, every search result highlighted into a persisted annotation set, and deletion of every existing highlight through individual annotation DELETE requests
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap. The browser contracts use a deterministic stateful annotation-service fake

capabilities.name: Image annotations and comments
capabilities.covered: Four Playwright Functional contracts preserve the historical user behaviours one-for-one against a deterministic stateful annotation-service fake: create a non-text image annotation and comment, draw-box geometry, comment update and comment deletion. Create and draw-box prove positive request geometry, rendered state and persistence after reload
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap identified in this standalone slice

capabilities.name: Bookmarks
capabilities.covered: All eight historical bookmark scenarios are retired. Playwright covers real text-selection contextual bookmark creation, panel creation, update, delete with sibling promotion, single and multiple empty drafts, document-position/custom sorting, rendered drag-reorder persistence and 30-bookmark lifecycle with deterministic bookmark API fixtures
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap in the self-contained slice. The Functional drag-reorder contract proves stateful fixture persistence after reload; live annotation-service ordering remains an external-service evidence question

capabilities.name: Index and outline
capabilities.covered: Both historical Codecept outline journeys are retired. Playwright uses the repository's 22-page bundle fixture to navigate Index Page to page 2 and the nested Prepared Discharge Final Order to page 8, asserting the rendered page input and selected parent/child outline state
capabilities.gap: No remaining legacy gap identified in this standalone slice

capabilities.name: Print and download
capabilities.covered: Both historical PDF action-only Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright reaches the visible toolbar or overflow menu, proves the loaded PDF URL is handed to the print API, and proves PDF.js hands the same URL plus configured filename to the browser download contract
capabilities.gap: Native browser print dialogs and download-manager UI are browser-owned; the functional contract asserts the exact hand-off inputs rather than treating a platform dialog as product state

capabilities.name: Redaction
capabilities.covered: Playwright covers all 12 historical redaction scenarios through real draw-box and text-selection gestures, combined markers, full-page and multi-page redaction, download then text-redaction sequencing, single-marker and clear-all deletion, preview state, search/redact-all persistence, redaction request payload, downloaded PDF filename and post-download reset. It exceeds legacy coverage with exact multi-page save aggregation, clear-all persistence across reload and multi-page selective-delete/reload contracts
capabilities.gap: No legacy migration gap. The browser contracts use deterministic redaction-service responses

capabilities.name: Multimedia playback
capabilities.covered: Both historical Codecept scenarios are retired. Playwright exceeds their action/screenshot coverage with MP4 readiness, real MP3 play/pause/rewind state transitions through keyboard interaction, disabled-player download behaviour and unsupported-media diagnostics
capabilities.gap: No remaining high-value gap identified in the standalone multimedia-player slice

capabilities.name: In-court presentation (ICP)
capabilities.covered: Deterministic unit/protocol contracts cover session-token handling, socket envelopes and follower zoom/rotation state, but no browser journey is claimed
capabilities.gap: No browser leader/follower journey or live Web PubSub session proof exists. Add that browser contract only if browser-level ICP evidence is required; live session-service/AAT proof remains an environment-owned gate
